GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide at 1200m and on rail at 1150m, railed up to 3.5 Lengths turning, steered only Two Wide Straightening Up and kept trying, moved to 4th place but only held its own ground in Straight # never a threat

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked Four Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line. Slow start was no help. # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied and obliged to shift out over the final 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 9 Lengths 3 Wide turning, carried wider at 300m, Made Some Ground down the outside in straight. (Blinkers AGAIN, Nasal Strip OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Rider reported intending to settle forward, howvere due to the quick tempo, was obliged to settle further back than anticipated. He added, after settling back, he was forced to make a Wide early run leaving the 500m.] # back/battled fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 300m carried wider. Rdr reported intention to be forward, however due to the quick speed in the race, obliged to settle further back than anticipated-added after settling back, forced to make a wide early run from leaving the 500m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped quite well & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide with a lap to go, Moved Up to 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # Wide from the turn

Jumped okay, Four Wide first turn, pressed on and into Two Wide joint Lead at the 1500m, Held Together out in front & led 3 Wide by a length turning, Headed Straightening Up and faded a little to the line. # fading 3rd place
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 2 Lengths Four Wide , Moved Up Two Wide Outside Lead at the 1000m, held together much same to turn trailing 0.75 Lengths , Moved Up to challenge after Straightening Up and kept going in Straight taking narrow Lead 40m from post. (Bit Lifter FIRST TIME) # solid win
Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground in Straight # battled on ok

Jumped okay & Settled Down on fence trailing 0.75 Lengths , held together much same to turn 2nd on fence trailing 2 Lengths , shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and kept battling in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Passing the 1200m was bumped by BUMP’N’RUN, which when over racing shifted in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok settled down better than Mid Field fence 5 Lengths (1200m), Under Pressure 500, same into the Straight shown stick rallying though, kept on coming just running out of Ground (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME) # kept coming/almost!
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Some Ground to 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, kept trying in Straight # mostly wide/ran ok

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.
